learning_outcomes: write functionally correct Java programs that solve a specified problem and/or meet a provided specification.
break down problems into subproblems that are modular and reusable, and define methods to represent those subproblems
select and apply control structures (e.g., methods, loops, conditionals) to manage the flow of control and information in programs.
select and apply basic data abstractions (e.g., variables, parameters, arrays) to manage and manipulate data in programs.
define programs that are well-written, readable, maintainable, and conform to established standards
identify and fix bugs and errors that occur during the development process
identify and utilize resources to help overcome difficulties or resolve errors in developing programs
elaborate on the potential and limitations of computing systems on our society.
topics: Introduction to the Class and Computing
Ethical Reasoning and Starting to Program

skills.evidence: Applying foundational ideas of computing to frame a problem and devise a solution using Java programming language
covering the following sub-topics: Expression and evaluation
covering the following sub-topics: Variables, state, and data types
covering the following sub-topics: Sequential execution of statements
covering the following sub-topics: Conditional statements
covering the following sub-topics: Loop and Iterations
covering the following sub-topics: Managing and manipulating data (with arrays)
covering the following sub-topics: Abstraction and modular programming
